body:
Adds `research/stiction-twin` (follow-up to `backlash-twin`): a frictionless or Coulomb-only twin predicts the PID loop converges. With Fs = Fc the real loop does converge (15/15 cases). A breakaway excess ΔF = Fs − Fc makes it stick-slip hunt at about 0.54–0.93 ΔF/kp in four of five gain settings, independent of Fc. Short runs can mistake a long stick for convergence.

- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok (168 projects).
- 8 unit tests pass; `experiments/results.txt` is the output of `experiments/run.py`.
- Stylised, simulated "real" plant; no closed form for the amplitude constant (stated in the paper).
